normalize_text: normalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, digits, and extra spaces for a given ISO language code
normalize_text_with_brackets: normalize text and remove all bracketed content including references like biblical citations
normalize_text_keep_numbers: normalize text while preserving standalone numbers instead of removing digit-only words
normalize_text_preserve_case: normalize text without converting to lowercase while still removing punctuation and extra spaces
review_text_normalize: review the text_normalize function to understand its normalization pipeline for ASR text preprocessing
